description: IA-58A c/n 067, on charge November 1981; flew from Comodoro Rivadavia in April 1982 including torpedo drops over Golfo San Jorge. Trucked from Reconquista October 2016 and erected on the airport access roundabout for the ex-combatants' union; photographed March 2018.
museum_name: Pucará A-566 Rotonda Héctor Bordón Monument, Comodoro Rivadavia
